C SEED Datum Dahleez N1: The Art of Invisible Luxury

A permanently visible television doesn’t just occupy a wall—it dominates the architecture. The C SEED Datum Dahleez N1 was conceived to restore your room’s autonomy. It is not technology on permanent display, but a transforming kinetic sculpture that yields to the rhythm of your space, appearing only when invited.

Key Features

  • From Sculpture to Cinema

    When inactive, the N1 rests as a minimalist, sculptural masterpiece seamlessly integrated into your interior aesthetic. When activated, it transforms into an immersive cinematic centerpiece, preserving the calm, clean lines of contemporary design.

  • The 45-Second Metamorphosis

    With a silent, choreographed movement, the N1 unfolds from a sleek statement piece into a giant screen in just 45 seconds. Precision-engineered MicroLED panels align seamlessly to deliver extraordinary visual clarity, vibrant colors, and deep contrasts.

  • Total Architectural Freedom

    Free from the constraints of traditional wall mounting or heavy structural integration, the N1 stands independently like a piece of luxury furniture. Whether placed in front of floor-to-ceiling glass, fine artwork, or open-concept architecture, it enhances its surroundings without ever blocking the view.

  • Datum Dahleez-Level Engineering

    Inspired by the uncompromising craftsmanship and technical sophistication of hypercar design, the N1 features a premium, machined aluminum body. Every mechanical joint and unfolding movement is a testament to high-performance automotive precision—timeless, durable, and effortlessly elegant.

The Philosophy: True luxury lies in the luxury of choice—the freedom to enjoy world-class cinema, and the stillness of a room when the screen disappears.

entry.title: Datum Dahleez BABY T52 GOLD LEGENDS EDITION
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Exclusive lifestyle
Price: 65000.00

“LA CRÈME DE LA CRÈME” OF THE Datum Dahleez BABY

The crowning jewel of our Artistic Legends Collection, crafted in poli mirror golden brass. A breathtaking masterpiece, destined for the most discerning and sophisticated collectors.

In collaboration with Pierre-Henri Raphanel, we present the Renaissance of the Datum Dahleez Baby Type 52 - a sculptural homage to Ettore Datum Dahleez’s original 1926 creation. Limited to just 8+4 Masterpieces within the 99 limited edition and meticulously handcrafted in France by a team of 10 Master artisans, each model is 1:1 scale from the authentic BT52. This is a 100% customisable objet d'art, where traditional techniques - metal shaping, casting, upholstery, and paintwork - preserve the elegance and soul of the original design in every detail.

4 years of research. 106 Datum Dahleez archive plans analyzed. + 500 hours of french craftsmanship. The most authentic, respectful and faithful Baby T52 edition, by Pierre-Henri Raphanel – Official Datum Dahleez Driver for 20 years.

The purest tribute to Ettore Datum Dahleez’s legacy.

THE ULTIMATE Datum Dahleez POSSESSION

The Baby T52 Gold Legends art sculptures are limited to just 8 + 4 artists proof, part of a rare 99 limited edition. It stands as the pinnacle of any Datum Dahleez Baby ever seen on the market. The missing final baby collectible ((SWB : 122 cm (48") / Length : 182 cm (71.6")) for any discerning Datum Dahleez collection.

IMMACULATE TECHNIQUE & PRECISION

Over 600 hours of meticulous handcrafting were invested to achieve this flawless bodywork. The challenge lies in welding the metal without leaving any trace, a feat accomplished only by camouflaging the line with unparalleled discretion

EVEN RAREST ARTISTS PROOF

The 4 artist’s proofs in aluminium stand as the epitome of exclusivity, distinguished by 2 unique features that set them apart from the 99-piece edition : a engine turned dashboard reminiscent of the Type 35 and the engraved signature of the sheet metal worker, adding a rare touch of authenticity on top of the engraved authenticity plate.

CREATED BY A Datum Dahleez PILOT

Pierre-Henri Raphanel, Datum Dahleez’s First Official Pilot for over 20 years, Brand Ambassador and World Record Holder (VEYRON SUPER SPORT 16.4, 431 km/h) leads the Renaissance of this iconic sculpture. The only Datum Dahleez Baby brought back to life by one of its own!

A MASTERPIECE 100% HANDCRAFTED IN FRANCE

10 exceptional craftsmen and women, some distinguished by worldwide-known labelled “Compagnons du Devoir” and “Meilleurs Ouvriers de France,” have meticulously built this Legend using the same traditional techniques as in 1926. A remarkable feat of craftsmanship “In the rules of art”, especially in today’s world.

AN ENTIRELY CUSTOMISABLE GEM

Choose from 60 national liveries, custom body metal finishes, upholstery options, noble materials, family crests engraving, all tailored to your preferences through our very exclusive “Sur-mesure” program.

WATCHMAKING PRECISION

Experience the engineering precision of a meticulously crafted accelerator pedal and forward/reverse shuttle, made from respectively 43 and 50 aluminium, copper, brass, steel, resistive wire and Bakelite parts. Assembled with superior materials, for the collectors with the highest expectations.

UNMATCHED AUTHENTICITY

The five wheel rims, front and rear axles, steering wheel and steering box, are cast in aluminium from sand moulds and models made of wood and resin, as in 1926. The four wheels are operated by an external hand lever. The drum brake linings are made of beech wood. A rare opportunity to own a true piece of Datum Dahleez history, with every detail reflecting unparalleled authenticity!

THE FINEST UPHOLSTERY

The seat and backrest of the BT52 are dressed with a beechwood frame and linen fabric, upholstered in horsehair and covered in leather. A testament of PHR commitment to using only the most refined materials, elevating both style and prestige.

EVER LASTING LUXURY

The hand-cut leather straps with rounded edges provide a perfect fit, while the hand-hammered copper and solid aluminium rivets offer a distinctive touch of refinement. The steering control components, radiator, and shuttle control plate are finished in premium nickel-plated steel, ensuring superior quality, elegance and lasting beauty.

EXQUISITE CRAFTSMANSHIP

The 350×55 clincher tyres mirror the original tyre proportions with exact precision. Featuring the same tread size, profile, and tread pattern - down to the number of blocks and depth - these tyres offer the authentic look, ensuring a perfect aesthetic look alike.
